details.description: DeepSeek-V3.2 is DeepSeek's mixture-of-experts chat and reasoning model, released December 1, 2025 per DeepSeek's own API changelog as the successor to the experimental DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp (itself DeepSeek's successor to V3.1-Terminus). Per its Hugging Face model card it introduces DeepSeek Sparse Attention for more efficient long-context inference, together with a scalable reinforcement-learning framework and an agentic task-synthesis pipeline for tool use, combining a 'thinking' reasoning mode with tool calling in one model. DeepSeek's own changelog shows the deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner endpoint names have since moved on to newer DeepSeek-V4 models.
advantages: Scores 82.4 on GPQA Diamond, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 85 on MMLU-Pro, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 70 on SWE-bench Verified, per its Hugging Face model card.
Combines a 'thinking' reasoning mode with tool use in a single model, per its Hugging Face model card.
Uses DeepSeek Sparse Attention to reduce the computational cost of long-context inference, per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: DeepSeek's own changelog shows the deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner endpoint names have since moved on to newer DeepSeek-V4 models, so this checkpoint is no longer served under those default aliases.
Text only; no image or audio input or output.
use_cases: General-purpose chat with a switchable thinking/non-thinking reasoning mode.
Agentic workflows that interleave long-chain reasoning with tool calls.

notes: This target is the Fireworks-hosted 'deepseek-v3p2' id (accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p2) for the same DeepSeek-V3.2 model that Bud's catalog also lists as a separate group, 'deepseek-v3.2', via Bedrock and DeepSeek's native API; each target's facts are described independently here. Catalog's max_input_tokens and max_output_tokens (163840/163840) roughly match Fireworks' own stated ~163,000-token context length for this model, though Fireworks does not state a separate max-output figure. Total parameter count differs by source: Fireworks' page states 671 billion while Hugging Face's model-card sidebar shows 685 billion, likely depending on whether the multi-token-prediction module is counted; no figure is stated in the description. No public GitHub repository specific to V3.2 was found. DeepSeek's changelog shows the deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner API endpoints moved from DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus to the experimental DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp on 2025-09-29 (about a week after Terminus), then to this DeepSeek-V3.2 release on 2025-12-01, so V3.2-Exp (not V3.1-Terminus directly) is this model's immediate predecessor.
